title: Meet the lawmaker who’s worried about Christian nationalism
description: Rep. Jared Huffman is concerned about religious freedom.

title: Trump promises Americans $5K if GOP wins. And, Kirk supporters reflect on his death
description: President Trump tries to incentivize voters by promising $5,000 to Americans if the GOP wins the midterms. And, young conservatives reflect on the party one year after Charlie Kirk's death.

title: Trump gives primetime speech at GOP convention, promising payout if Republicans win
description: President Trump kicked off the Republican midterm convention with a primetime speech, outlining the Republican message and promising Americans a payout if the GOP wins the upcoming election.

title: Veteran pollster shares takeaways from Trump's convention speech
description: Veteran pollster and political consultant Frank Luntz gives an analysis of President Trump's speech at the Republicans' midterm convention.

title: After Trump promised to pay $5,000 if Republicans win, here's what to expect Thursday
description: President Trump promised to send every adult citizen $5,000, but only if Republicans maintain control of Congress in the midterm election, setting high expectations for the convention's final night.

title: A year after Charlie Kirk was killed, young conservatives navigate a divided movement
description: The death of Charlie Kirk was seen as a rallying call for young conservatives. One year later, the movement is wrestling with questions about its future.

title: Missouri clerk on what the battle over the state's electoral maps means for voters
description: NPR's Michel Martin asks Boone County, Missouri, clerk Brianna Lennon what the legal battle over the state's electoral maps means for voters there.

title: Trump gave Natalie Harp and 2 other aides $45,000 as gifts, report says
description: The Washington Post is reporting that the president gave $45,000 cash gifts to executive assistant Natalie Harp and two other White House aides.

title: Trump makes case for Iran war, promises $5,000 payouts if GOP wins midterms
description: The president accused Iran of trying to influence the midterm elections as escalating violence in the Middle East loomed over his convention.

title: Fetterman appears by video at GOP convention and says he will work with Trump
description: The U.S. senator from Pennsylvania described himself during his remarks as a “common-sense Democrat” who rejected socialism.

title: Trump officials target November for final approval of massive arch
description: A top National Park Service official, meeting with preservationists, rejected suggestions to change the planned 250-foot-tall arch’s size, design or location.

title: For many attending the GOP’s midterm convention, the main draw is Trump
description: Control of Congress next year seems at best a secondary concern for some at the event that has been dubbed ‘Trumpapalooza.’

title: Supreme Court is asked to settle Missouri dispute causing electoral chaos
description: The appeal comes after conflicting rulings on whether the state can use a new congressional map that favors Republicans for November’s midterm elections.

title: Fetterman, already at odds with his party, makes surprise video for GOP convention
description: The Pennsylvania Democrat has already had a strained relationship with many inside his party. In the video, he spoke about working with Trump but did not outright praise him.

title: Five takeaways from the New Hampshire primaries and an under-the-radar Senate race
description: Former Republican senator John E. Sununu and Democratic Rep. Chris Pappas easily won their primaries for an open U.S. Senate seat.

title: Trump accuses Iran of meddling in midterms as wave of missiles targets U.S. base in Jordan
description: Under economic pressure from the U.S., Iranian leaders have signaled they will not capitulate amid stunted diplomatic efforts to end the war.

title: Trump administration proposes changes to census that could exclude millions
description: If adopted, the changes could exclude millions of residents from the decennial tally, reshaping congressional representation in the country.

title: Newsom’s defamation lawsuit against  Fox News is set for March 2028 trial
description: A Delaware judge has set a March 2028 trial date for California Gov. Gavin Newsom’s $787 million defamation lawsuit against Fox News.

title: Republicans kick off unconventional midterm convention in Dallas with Trump speech
description: Republicans' first midterm convention, being touted as a "Trumpapalooza" by the Republican Party chairman, kicks off in Dallas with a program focused heavily on tax cuts and border security.

title: What Republicans are campaigning on for the midterms
description: They’d rather not talk about Trump and gas prices.

title: Oil’s rise past $100 per barrel deepens GOP’s midterm challenge
description: The high gas prices are likely to haunt Republican candidates through Election Day.

title: Holdout juror in Clancy case admitted ‘reasonable doubt,’ foreperson says
description: Lindsay Clancy's trial ended in a mistrial after the Massachusetts jury could not reach a unanimous decision in the triple-murder case.

title: A potential 2028 presidential contender plans $20 million to help Democrats
description: Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker has formed a political action committee to help elect Democrats as he dances around a presidential bid.

title: Andrew Tate is denied bail and will remain in jail during his extradition fight
description: Prosecutors told the court that Andrew and Tristan Tate boasted about having multiple passports and flying on private jets. But the Tates' lawyers argued they were only playing a role for their fans.

title: How much does Trump care about the GOP?
description: The president’s own public comments and actions have called his commitment into question.

title: How Canada, with elbows up, could hurt Trump in the midterms
description: The president's fight with our neighbor to the north — a constant over the course of his second term with a focus on trade — has turned ugly in recent weeks.

title: Trump is remodeling the White House. The group set up to protect it has stayed quiet.
description: The White House Historical Association, a nonprofit set up by Jacqueline Kennedy to preserve the building’s character, has declined to criticize the president’s changes.

title: Trump makes GOP midterm convention about himself, much to Democrats’ delight
description: At President Donald Trump’s urging, the GOP is staging a midterm convention centered on him.

title: Trump gave $45,000 cash gifts to Natalie Harp, two other close aides
description: Financial disclosures show the sums were equivalent to nearly one-third of each of their salaries. Experts say the gifts are without precedent and may violate the law.

title: Honoring 9/11 heroes, Trump repeats disputed account of his role in recovery
description: Trump awarded the Medal of Freedom posthumously to Welles Crowther, who saved an estimated 18 people before dying in the World Trade Center.

title: Conflicting court rulings leave Missouri congressional map in chaos
description: Supreme Court Justice Brett M. Kavanaugh and a federal judge issued opposite decisions on the fate of a congressional map that favored the GOP, leaving races in limbo.

title: Armed man charged after confronting Ohio governor candidate at county fair
description: The suspect pleaded not guilty to assault and inducing panic after pushing through a crowd toward Amy Acton. He was accused of knocking down two elderly people.

title: Authorities decline to prosecute woman who made false report against Buttigieg
description: The accuser has a history of alcohol abuse, hallucinations and delusional thinking, according to an Indiana prosecutor who determined she was not able to form criminal intent.

title: Sen. Roger Marshall’s challenger in Kansas criticizes him for suing patients
description: Adam Hamilton, a Methodist pastor, is facing an uphill battle against Marshall. No Democrat has won a Senate race in the state since 1932.

title: Paxton’s former top law enforcement official endorses Talarico
description: David Maxwell, a former Texas Ranger decorated for his decades of service, reported Paxton to the FBI in 2020.

title: DHS asks Supreme Court to let it use Social Security data to verify voter rolls
description: The case, seeking to help officials ensure potential voters are citizens, is among the election-related disputes the court is considering ahead of the midterms.

title: Supreme Court declines Catholic mother’s bid for son’s vaccine exemption in N.Y.
description: The Supreme Court on Tuesday rejected a New York woman's bid to send her son to kindergarten without state-mandated vaccines, a requirement that she claimed infringed on her religious rights.

title: Iceland summons U.S. envoy over Trump map depicting it in stars and stripes
description: A Trump post showed the country, along with Canada, Cuba, Mexico and Greenland, covered in red, white and blue, and labeled “United States of America.”

title: Why Ohio is such a competitive state this year
description: It’s got a major governor’s race, marquee Senate contest and House elections, all of which Democrats have a chance to win.

title: NYC voters give Mamdani high marks, say mayor is doing better than expected
description: A new Suffolk University poll also finds New York voters disagree with GOP calls for Mayor Zohran Mamdani to stay away from 9/11 memorial.

title: Lindsay Clancy’s attorney makes public plea for Trump pardon
description: Kevin Reddington also said he hoped to arrange an agreement with prosecutors that would be “acceptable to both sides.”
